runtime_prompt_en:
Create a vertical photorealistic full-body editorial photograph in a restored art-deco ferry terminal just after a hard rain. One unmistakably adult woman, carrying only facial and general appearance continuity from the supplied portrait, occupies most of the frame. Frame her head to toe, upright and large in the vertical frame, with natural anatomy and grounded feet. The complete outfit topology, neckline, both shoulders and sleeves, waist and closure or crotch and inseam region, legs, and hems must remain fully visible and readable in one vertical full-body frame. Dress her in a solid pale celadon functional wrap-front blouse with long sleeves and straight charcoal trousers, plus low-profile dark loafers. The lightweight matte crepe falls in fine dry-grained folds that reveal the lower panel edge. Two separate front-panel edges remain traceable from the wrap V neckline to the side fastening; one panel visibly continues beneath the other, and coherent fold depth proves a real diagonal overlap; the crossing edges form a coherent wrap V neckline, sharing one continuous edge path with the diagonal overlap; a side tie button or fixed seam holds the overlap, connecting both wrap panels under visible functional tension. A printed diagonal line does not substitute for panel overlap, and a decorative waist tie or loose scarf cannot carry the closure; actual lower-under-upper fabric depth distinguishes it from a faux seam or decorative bow. She is caught mid-handoff, extending a rain-speckled, wax-sealed archival parcel low and outward toward a dispatch clerk's gloved hand. The parcel stays entirely beside her silhouette and clear of blouse front, neckline, wrap edges, fastening, trouser closure, legs, and hems; her free arm opens away from her torso, exposing both shoulders and sleeves. A chest-level near-frontal camera keeps both blouse panels equally measurable. Soft rain-filtered station light skims both wrap-panel edges and preserves sculpted fold relief. Wet terrazzo, geometric glass, and the narrow brass parcel window establish the rainy terminal while the outfit stays dominant.

Avoid: cartoon style, excessive HDR, over-processed retouching, low resolution, illustration look, broken facial features, plastic-looking skin, fake-looking background, distorted fingers, flat collage look, inconsistent shadows, unmatched lighting, obvious cutout edges, CGI look, digital illustration
